detail.longDescription: Coding agents kept filling up my disk with stale worktrees and leaving branches behind, so I built Fresh to clean up merged branches and worktrees and switch back to the default branch after merging a PR. Then I added support for project-specific commands so I could clean up after the agents, install dependencies, build, and run the project in one action. I was tired of remembering a different string of commands for every project. Now for all my projects, it’s just one action: fresh.
